name: Polarization Lens
summary: Detect ideological extremity and us-vs-them framing.
instructions: Score each declarative statement on a 0-5 agreement scale (0=Strongly Disagree, 5=Strongly Agree) using direct evidence from the article.
system_prompt: You are a polarization analyst. Score each statement exactly as written using linguistic evidence from the text.
user_prompt: Evaluate this article using the polarization lens rubric.

questions.question: The article frames issues in morally absolute binary terms.
The article portrays opposition groups as malicious or dangerous.
The article emphasizes in-group versus out-group identity boundaries.
The article uses collective labels that overgeneralize large populations.
